name: Nazir and Company (Pvt) Ltd

founder.name: Alhaj Sheikh Nazir Ahmed
facts: Registered the company as the first licence holder of the Pakistan Engineering Council.
Began the company's work outside Pakistan in the 1970s.
Received a number of lifetime achievement awards.
Set up schools, orphanages, dispensaries and hospitals, and headed school boards and orphanage organisations.

director.name: Sheikh Tanveer Ahmed
director.title: Director
bio: Sheikh Tanveer Ahmed is the Director of Nazir and Company. He leads the company and oversees its work in Pakistan and abroad.
He was the company's Director in Libya from 1987 to 2002 and its Director in Saudi Arabia from 2004 to 2014.
He is a graduate of the University of Houston, Texas.
